element: Roof pitch, after the 13th-c change [[CORRECTED SCOPE. Two stated causes at two dates, not one: (i) mid-12th c, smaller scantlings force a steeper pitch - 'employant des bois moins gros, il fallait donner aux arbaletriers une plus grande inclinaison, afin qu'ils ne flechissent pas sous le poids de la couverture'; (ii) 13th c, the bahut has shrunk to about 1 m and the rafter foot plus purlin depth no longer fits on it.
